rules.description: SYN connection attempt to the gRPC endpoint (50051).
The HTTP/2 connection-preface byte pattern is present (cleartext E2 transport).
At least five payload-bearing TCP/50051 segments are present; this does not count HTTP/2 frames or gRPC messages.
SYN connection attempt to the raw-protobuf endpoint (50052).
PB1 marker bytes are present on TCP/50052; decode the complete raw-protobuf frame separately.

manual_checks: R1 R2 R3: Assert method outputs, deadline status and message counts independently of DATA-frame boundaries.
R4 R5: Decode PB1 and its length-delimited protobuf message at E2. Demonstrate Flex interoperability on this endpoint at E3.
